## whoami

Hi, I'm **Seifeddine**, a Computer Science student based in Düsseldorf 🇩🇪.
I like building solid backends and teaching machines to read between the lines.

- ☕ Building backends with **Java & Spring Boot**: a reservation system for student laundry rooms ([Waschsalon](https://github.com/seifeddine2003/Waschsalon)) and a REST + MySQL analytics service ([SpringShopAnalytics](https://github.com/seifeddine2003/SpringShopAnalytics)).
- 🤖 Into **Machine Learning & NLP**: compared TF-IDF, BERT and DistilBERT for [fake news detection](https://github.com/seifeddine2003/fake_news_detection), reaching **98.63% accuracy** with fine-tuned DistilBERT.
- 📊 Sharpening my **data science** skills with Python, pandas and Jupyter.
- 🌱 Always learning: clean architecture, databases, and turning models into real products.
- 💬 Ask me about **Spring Boot, SQL or transformer models**.

<br>
